name: Sikalastic-777
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-777: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-777, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikalastic-777.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-777 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-777 is a high performance, hand-applied, low VOC, moisture-curing single component elastomeric polyurethane membrane with excellent root-resistance properties.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-777 is designed for the following waterproofing applications:
    - Planter boxes
    - Retaining walls
    - Foundation and basement walls
    - Below ground applications
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-777
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Root-resistant polyurethane waterproofing membrane
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. AS/NZS 4654.1:2012- Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/NZ4858: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Characteristics / Advantages (p.1).
    - AS/NZS 4654.1:2012: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Excellent root resistance properties
    - Low VOC, complies with Green Star requirements
    - UV resistant
    - Quick tack-free surface
    - High resistance to stagnant water
    - High resistance to puncture
    - High elongation, Class III membrane >300% according to AS/NZ4858
    - Single component, ready to use
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Single-pack moisture curing polyurethane
    - Colour: Black
    - Density: 1.30-1.35 (g/cm3)
    - Viscosity: 10,000 - 18,000 cP @30RPM
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 250g/L
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: 70 Shore A
    - Tensile strength: 6 MPa
    - Tensile strain at break: > 300%
    - Tear strength: 20 kN/m
    - Service temperature: -20 to +80°C
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 15 Litres
    - Shelf life: 9 months
    - Storage conditions: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. In the case of a high porosity substrate, it is recommended to use an epoxy primer. Please see 'priming' section below for further information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Curing time: 24 hours for full cure.
    - Drying time: Sikalastic®-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.
4.3 Dry film thickness. Vertical applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.670 litres (670 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1 mm dry film thickness. Floor applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.8 litre (800 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1.2 mm dry film thickness. Minimum 1-1.2mm DFT recommended on all applications.
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-777 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-777 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate Sikalastic®- 777 with Sika Thinner C or for the best results remove the existing coating back to substrate and re-apply.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not install Sikalastic®-777 without the use of a primer.
    - Do not under apply Sikalastic®-777 as this will impact the products performance, UV resistance and cause premature degradation.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Relative air humidity. Between 20 and 90%
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 to +35°C
5.4 Substrate moisture content. Up to 5%
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-777, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikalastic-777.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalastic 777, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/MSDS%20Sikalastic-777%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
